summary: Frontend-only regression of the new Dark Theme feature at 390x844 web preview, demo@hibinomi.app / water123. All seven spec checkpoints pass. (1) Default (no 'theme' key in localStorage + system=light): Home/Reports/Reminders/Profile and Settings all render light (body/wrapper #F2FBFC rgb(242,251,252), cards white rgb(255,255,255)). (2) Settings → 'Units & display' card renders Theme segment with the three testIDs theme-system / theme-light / theme-dark and labels 'System' / 'Light' / 'Dark'; the 'System' pill is visually selected by default. Tapping theme-dark fires toast 'Theme updated' (text node confirmed) and the screen flips to dark instantly — body bg #0B1220, cards #121D31 (rgb(18,29,49)), muted/foreground readable. (3) Dark scan across tabs: large white blocks counted on each dark page = 0/0/0/0 for Home / Reports / Reminders / Profile — Reports calendar + chart legend ('Target met / Below target / Goal') and the week-chart surface readable, Reminders chip row + Active-window card legible, Profile cards use the dark surface. (4) Sheets in dark: edit-presets-button → PresetsSheet renders on dark surface, 'New size (ml)' input has bg #1B2A44 / color #E6F1F5 (readable); quick-add-custom → 'Add custom amount' sheet same, input bg #1B2A44 / color #E6F1F5. (5) Persistence: localStorage['theme']="dark" after tap; after full reload body stays dark and quick-add + today's-log cards stay dark; logging out via Sign out shows the login screen rendered dark (login card dark, 'Signed out' toast, no big white cards: count=0); logging back in keeps dark. (6) theme-light tap: toast 'Theme updated', instantly flips back to light (5 big white cards appear), localStorage['theme']="light". (7) theme-system → page.emulate_media(color_scheme='dark') + reload renders dark (5 dark cards #121D31); emulate_media(color_scheme='light') + reload renders light (5 white cards). (8) i18n: switching to Japanese via language-ja renders Theme labels as システム / ライト / ダーク and the toast as 'テーマを更新しました' when tapping theme-dark; switched back to language-en, then set theme-system at the end — final state verified localStorage theme="system", language="en". Status bar style flip (dark↔light) wired via ThemedStatusBar in app/_layout.tsx and confirmed via scheme-dependent StatusBar prop. Only pre-existing console warnings observed (shadow* deprecation, expo-notifications web limitation, pointerEvents style prop) — unrelated. No functional defects found.
critical_code_review_comments: src/context/theme.tsx — on web, Appearance.setColorScheme is a no-op (RN-web stub). The scheme switch here still works because the computed `scheme` is derived from React's useColorScheme + preference, but on native it will double-flip through Appearance; worth a `if (Platform.OS !== 'web')` guard to avoid future dev-mode warnings.

src/context/theme.tsx L41 — `preference === 'system' ? (system === 'dark' ? 'dark' : defaultScheme)` defaults any non-'dark' value (incl. null during SSR/hydration) to 'light'. Fine on web because useColorScheme reads prefers-color-scheme synchronously, but if useColorScheme ever returns null transiently (RN 0.73+ supports this), the first paint can flash light before correcting. Memoisation hides this today — monitor.

app/settings.tsx L160 — the Theme segment Pressables set `accessibilityRole='radio'` + `accessibilityState={{ selected }}`, but on react-native-web this does not emit aria-checked/aria-selected (verified via DOM scan — both attrs are null). Screen-reader selection parity is lost on the web preview. Consider adding `aria-checked={on}` via `role` + direct `aria-checked` prop (web only) or a Platform.select override.

app/_layout.tsx — ThemeProvider sits ABOVE AuthProvider, so the Splash shown while loading=true already uses saved theme (good). But the ErrorBoundary at the root falls back to `fallback` in theme.ts (light only). A caught crash in dark mode will flash a white screen — maybe mirror the saved pref inside the boundary via document.documentElement data attribute.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every spec checkpoint passed (default light, theme-dark + toast, dark across 4 tabs & 2 sheets, reload persistence, logout/login persistence, theme-light switch, theme-system w/ emulate_media dark+light, JA labels + JA toast, final state system/en)

seed_data_creation: None. No profile fields or intake rows mutated. localStorage key 'theme' was toggled through dark→light→system during the test; final value is 'system'. localStorage['language'] left at 'en'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme preference lives ONLY in AsyncStorage key 'theme' (web: localStorage, JSON-stringified as '"system"' / '"light"' / '"dark"'); no backend sync. Scheme is derived via useColorScheme() + preference in src/context/theme.tsx. To force the 'System' branch in Playwright use page.emulate_media(color_scheme='dark'|'light') then reload — the provider does not re-render on live media changes without a reload because useColorScheme on RN-web only reflects the initial match on mount (verified during this run). testIDs: theme-system / theme-light / theme-dark, edit-presets-button, quick-add-custom, menu-settings, language-en/id/ja. Login testIDs: login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button. Tab labels have duplicate text nodes on web (header + tab bar) — prefer URL navigation (/, /reports, /reminders, /profile, /settings) over get_by_text clicks. Pre-existing non-blocking web quirks: modal sheets may overlap the tab bar; (tabs)/_layout.tsx has pre-existing TS ColorValue warnings — ignore both.
